recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core. If the work group still wants standard extensions for external rule/ruleset metadata, evaluate that in the FHIR Testing IG or extension-maintenance workflow rather than restoring or editing removed core TestScript files.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core TestScript issue for STU3/R4 requesting removal of the TestScript rule and ruleset elements due to compatibility issues across FHIR test engines, with extensions recommended for implementations that still need external-rules metadata.
initial_application: Commit 2adf2bc16064ef00751f144ee1437455bba61b42 applied the issue in historical core source, explicitly saying "GF 17510 - rule and ruleset elements removed", deleting the rule-based TestScript example, and removing TestScript.rule, TestScript.ruleset, and assert rule/ruleset children while retaining assert.expression.
additional_context: Current core no longer owns TestScript: source/fhir.ini lists the FHIR Testing IG as an additional IG, TestScript is absent from the active core [resources] list, and commit f9a44787c45071394532c7c2ee94d76f30f47387 removed TestScript/TestReport/TestPlan source from core. The current FHIR Testing IG TestScript StructureDefinition also lacks the removed rule/ruleset elements and retains assert.expression. FHIR-19284 shared the same 2018 application commit and is already represented on the combined branch as an external-repo audit.
reconciliation: No core source was changed. The current core checkout is not the authoritative TestScript definition, and the current external TestScript artifact already reflects the FHIR-17510 removal.
